claims: Grand Theft Auto VI is currently scheduled to be released on November 19, 2026.
Grand Theft Auto VI was delayed from its initial 2025 and earlier 2026 windows to ensure a high level of polish for the launch.
Grand Theft Auto VI is confirmed for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The setting of Grand Theft Auto VI is the state of Leonida (based on Florida) and Vice City.
Grand Theft Auto VI has dual protagonists Jason and Lucia.
According to reports, the delayed date for Grand Theft Auto VI follows internal decisions to refine the game, similar to previous Rockstar titles like Red Dead Redemption 2.
